site.title: Obelisk: the Discord alternative with Nostr login
site.description: Obelisk is the Discord alternative for crypto and privacy communities. Log in with your Nostr keys, no email or password: servers, voice and encrypted DMs.

jsonLd.websiteDescription: Discord alternative with Nostr login: no email, no password. Group chat for crypto and privacy communities.
jsonLd.appDescription: Discord alternative powered by Nostr identity. Log in with your keys: no email, no password. Includes servers, channels, voice, encrypted DMs and Web of Trust spam resistance.

app.title: Open the app: group chat signed with your keys
app.description: Open Obelisk in your browser: group chat, voice channels and encrypted DMs over Nostr relays, signed with your own keys. No email, no password, no account.

voice.title: Voice room: test a peer-to-peer call on Nostr
voice.description: Join a test voice room on Obelisk: pick a room name, open it on two devices with two Nostr keys and talk peer to peer over WebRTC, signaling on the relay.

features.title: Features: Nostr group chat, calls and games
features.description: NIP-29 groups, voice messages, sticker packs, relay-native games, a mobile app, P2P video and large SFU calls, all on Nostr with portable profiles you own.

help.title: Help: Nostr login, relays, communities, zaps
help.description: Help with Obelisk: logging in with Nostr keys, joining and running relay-based communities, privacy, Lightning payments and Bitcoin zaps, in plain words.

helpLocalData.title: Help: what Obelisk keeps on your device
helpLocalData.description: What Obelisk stores in your browser and why, how to remove each part from Settings or from the browser, and what clearing your device does not remove.

mediaKit.title: Media kit: Obelisk logos, banners and colors
mediaKit.description: The Obelisk press and media kit: logos, banners, icons, brand colors, ready-made copy and HTML banners you can embed, free to use when you write about it.

guides.title: Guides to Obelisk, Nostr and relay communities
guides.description: Long-form guides to Obelisk: how Nostr identity works, running a relay community, Web of Trust spam resistance, Bitcoin zaps, games and what comes next.

notFound.title: Page not found: it never existed or it moved
notFound.description: There is no page at this address on Obelisk. It may have moved or never existed; head back to the home page to find the guides, the help pages and the app.

desktop.title: Desktop tour: a Discord alternative on Nostr
desktop.description: A tour of Obelisk on desktop: NIP-29 group chat, publications, voice channels over an SFU, encrypted DMs and Lightning zaps. No email and no password.

gallery.name: Obelisk on desktop: screenshot tour
gallery.description: Screenshots of Obelisk, a Nostr-powered Discord alternative, captured in a desktop browser.

shots.voice: Large voice channel via SFU on desktop

mobile.title: Mobile tour: Discord-style group chat on Nostr
mobile.description: Obelisk on your phone: NIP-29 group chat, voice channels, encrypted DMs and Lightning zaps, installable as an app. No email, no password, just your keys.

gallery.name: Obelisk on mobile: screenshot tour
gallery.description: Screenshots of Obelisk, a Nostr-powered Discord alternative, captured on a phone.

shots.login: Sign in with Nostr on mobile

laCrypta.title: La Crypta on Obelisk: Nostr group chat
